name: Command Inspector
hypothesis: A global capture/search spine plus a contextual inspector makes rapid re-entry and keyboard-oriented editing faster than browsing a hierarchy.
optimize_for: fast retrieval, continuity, and direct manipulation
tradeoff: The model is less discoverable for users who prefer visible browse-first navigation and can make empty search states feel stark.

axes.information_architecture: global task index with selected context
axes.workflow_model: capture or search then inspect then act
axes.navigation_model: command/search spine with compact list index
axes.composition_model: result list plus persistent detail inspector
axes.content_hierarchy: current query and selected task before list chrome
axes.density: medium density with high context continuity
axes.disclosure: inspector reveals notes and status controls
axes.interaction_model: keyboard-first command entry and contextual editing
axes.search_filter_model: prominent global search across lists and tasks
axes.visual_language: editorial dark-on-light workspace with command accent
